content: Hey, I’ve been thinking about how to express my feelings about the Supreme Court’s decision in Dobbs v. Jackson. I really want to post something strong on Twitter, but I’m worried about how heated the responses can get. Any thoughts on how to make my point without inviting a ton of backlash?

I understand that you want to express your feelings about the Supreme Court’s decision in Dobbs v. Jackson. It’s important to remember that everyone has the right to their own opinion, but it’s also crucial to respect others’ opinions. You could try framing your post in a way that focuses on your personal feelings and experiences, rather than making a blanket statement. For example, you could share why this decision matters to you personally, or how it has impacted you or others you know. This can help to keep the conversation more respectful and constructive. Remember, it’s okay to disagree with others, but it’s important to do so in a respectful and understanding manner.
